results.content: As of 2026[update], there are 21 EU member states in the eurozone, of which the first 11 (Austria, Belgium, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Portugal, and Spain) introduced the euro on 1 January 1999 when it was electronic only.
